cookies.title: Cookie Policy

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.paragraph1: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them on our website, and your choices regarding cookies.
introduction.paragraph2: Important: This site uses cookies ONLY for analytics (if you consent). If you reject analytics, NO cookies are set. We use localStorage (browser storage) for essential functionality, which is NOT cookies and stays only in your browser.

whatAreCookies.title: What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.description: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device (computer, smartphone, or tablet) when you visit a website. Cookies are sent to the server with every HTTP request you make to the website.
whatAreCookies.purpose: Cookies help websites remember your preferences, understand how you use the site, and improve your browsing experience. Unlike localStorage, cookies are transmitted to the server with each request.

cookiesVsLocalStorage.title: Cookies vs localStorage: What's the Difference?
cookiesVsLocalStorage.intro: It's important to understand the difference between cookies and localStorage:

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: Small text files sent to the server with every HTTP request. Used for tracking and analytics. Require consent under privacy laws.

localStorage.title: localStorage (Browser Storage)
localStorage.description: Data stored only in your browser that NEVER leaves your device. Used for preferences like theme and language. No consent needed as it's purely local.

cookiesVsLocalStorage.keyDifference: Key Difference: Cookies are sent to servers; localStorage stays in your browser.

actualCookies.title: Actual Cookies Used on This Site
actualCookies.intro: This website uses cookies ONLY for analytics, and ONLY if you consent:

analytics.title: Firebase Analytics Cookies (Non-Essential - Require Consent)
analytics.description: These cookies are set by Firebase Analytics to track user interactions and engagement anonymously. They help us understand how visitors use our website.
analytics.nonEssential: These cookies are non-essential and require your consent.
analytics.purpose: Analytics cookies help us improve the website by understanding which pages are most popular, how visitors navigate the site, and where errors occur.
analytics.ifRejected: If you reject analytics: ZERO cookies are set. The site works perfectly without any cookies.

cookieList.title: Specific Cookies We Use
cookieList.intro: Below is a detailed list of the actual cookies used on our website (ONLY if you consent to analytics):

firebaseAnalytics.title: Firebase Analytics Cookies (Google)

gat.purpose: Request throttling - Throttles request rate to prevent server overload

browserStorage.title: Browser Storage (localStorage) - NOT Cookies
browserStorage.intro: This site uses localStorage for essential functionality. localStorage is NOT cookies:
browserStorage.keyDifference: Key Difference: localStorage data NEVER leaves your browser. It is not sent to any server.
browserStorage.noConsentNeeded: No consent needed: Because localStorage stays purely local, it doesn't require consent under privacy laws.
browserStorage.howToManage: How to manage localStorage: You can clear localStorage through your browser's developer tools or by clearing all site data. This will reset your preferences but won't affect cookies.

manageCookies.title: How to Manage Cookies
manageCookies.intro: You can control and manage cookies in several ways. Please note that removing or blocking cookies may impact your user experience and some features may no longer work properly.

chrome.title: Google Chrome
chrome.step1: Click the three-dot menu icon in the top-right corner
chrome.step2: Select 'Settings' > 'Privacy and security' > 'Cookies and other site data'
chrome.step4: To delete existing cookies, click 'See all site data and permissions' > 'Remove all'

firefox.title: Mozilla Firefox
firefox.step1: Click the three-line menu icon in the top-right corner
firefox.step3: Under 'Cookies and Site Data', choose your preferred settings
firefox.step4: To delete existing cookies, click 'Clear Data'

safari.title: Safari
safari.step3: Choose your cookie preferences under 'Cookies and website data'
safari.step4: To delete existing cookies, click 'Manage Website Data' > 'Remove All'

edge.title: Microsoft Edge
edge.step1: Click the three-dot menu icon in the top-right corner
edge.step2: Select 'Settings' > 'Cookies and site permissions' > 'Cookies and site data'
edge.step4: To delete existing cookies, click 'See all cookies and site data' > 'Remove all'
